title: Full Stack Web Development Faculty / Trainer
description:
**About the Role**

Omniskill Hub Private Limited is looking for a passionate and technically skilled **Full Stack Web Development Faculty / Trainer** to train students in modern web development technologies. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of frontend and backend development, database management, and practical project development.

Freshers with strong technical knowledge, hands-on project experience, and a passion for teaching are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct practical and theory-based classes on full stack web development.
* Teach frontend technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React.js, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS.
* Train students in backend development using Node.js, Express.js, and the MERN stack.
* Teach database management using MySQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
* Guide students through real-world projects, assignments, coding exercises, and portfolio development.
* Explain programming concepts, debugging techniques, API integration, and responsive web design.
* Prepare course materials, practical exercises, assessments, and project-based learning activities.
* Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Stay updated with modern web development technologies, tools, and industry practices.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Frontend Development**

* HTML5 and CSS3
* JavaScript (ES6+)
* React.js
* Bootstrap
* Tailwind CSS
* Responsive web design

**Backend Development**

* Node.js
* Express.js
* MERN stack development (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)

**Database Management**

* MySQL
* MongoDB
* PostgreSQL

**Additional Skills (Preferred)**

* PHP and Laravel
* WordPress development
* Android application development
* Git and GitHub
* REST API development and integration
* Basic deployment and hosting knowledge

**Eligibility Criteria**

* BCA, MCA, B.Tech, B.Sc. Computer Science, or an equivalent qualification in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Strong fundamentals in web development and programming.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and guide students through practical implementation.
* Good communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* A willingness to learn new technologies and work in a student-focused training environment.

**Freshers are welcome!** Candidates with academic projects, personal projects, internships, or a strong portfolio can apply even without prior teaching experience.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build a career in technical education and professional training.
* A collaborative and learning-oriented work environment.
* Opportunities to work on practical projects and improve technical expertise.
* Career growth opportunities based on skills, performance, and contribution.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume. Please mention relevant technical skills, personal or academic projects, GitHub profile, and any teaching or internship experience in your application.

**Join Omniskill Hub and help aspiring developers build industry-relevant skills.**

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
